text: Figure 6.84: Dlt configuration of DltLogChannels and DltMessages [TPS_SYST_02264] Usage of DltLogChannel⌈In each DltConfig the Physi- calChannels that are used to transport the log and trace messages are configured by the DltLogChannel elements. Each DltLogChannel points to one PduTriggering in the role txPduTriggering to describe the Dlt Pdu that is transmitted by the DltLogChannel. The rxPduTrig- gering role is used to describe the Dlt Pdu that is received by the DltLogChannel. The DltLogChannel defines the applicationId and contextId that are used to identify the source of the log and trace message. ⌋() 486 of 1928 — AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL — Document ID 63: AUTOSAR_TPS_SystemT emplate
